name: npm-auto-discovery
description: Auto-discover Docker containers and create Nginx Proxy Manager proxy hosts

scripts.build:sea: tsup --config tsup.sea.config.ts && node --experimental-sea-config sea-config.json && cp $(which node) npm-auto-discovery && npx postject npm-auto-discovery NODE_SEA_BLOB sea-prep.blob --sentinel-fuse NODE_SEA_FUSE_fce680ab2cc467b6e072b8b5df1996b2 && chmod +x npm-auto-discovery && rm sea-prep.blob
scripts.pm2:start: (test -f ./npm-auto-discovery || npm run build:sea) && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && pm2 start pm2.sea.config.cjs
scripts.pm2:start:node: (test -f dist/main.cjs || npm run build) && pm2 start pm2.node.config.cjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check && npm test && npm run build

author: MOD4EVER <git@mod4ever.de>
